title: Pressure Check — Manual Operation Status

fields.headline: Manual Operation Confirmed — Pressure Stable
fields.narration: The MillbrookAlert system has broadcast a new public update. The city confirms the plant is operating in full manual mode, with all chemical feeds under direct oversight. Water quality is being tested every two hours, and pressure in Zone 1 is stable at 52 psi. The Do Not Drink advisory remains in effect. The city is working with the Ohio EPA and CISA to verify system safety before restoring automatic control.
keyFacts: Pressure in Zone 1 is stable at 52 psi
Water quality tested every two hours under manual control
Do Not Drink advisory remains active
System verification underway with Ohio EPA and CISA
fields.expectedAction: The PIO confirms the public statement is released via MillbrookAlert, the city website, and all social media channels using the pre-scripted language from MDWS-PCP-2026, Section 10.
fields.scenarioTitle: pH on the Edge — Caustic Overfeed & Public Health

instructorNote: This inject confirms the public has received a status update. The PIO must now validate that the message was disseminated on all channels as required by the PCP.
